structural_hypothesis: A bounded verifier branch improves material-claim accuracy enough to justify its cost.
risk_expansion: One additional model call; no new permissions or side effects.
state_migration: Add optional VerificationV1 channel; old checkpoints remain readable.
credit_assignment: Compare baseline, full candidate, and candidate without verifier.
held_out_gate: Accuracy delta at least five percentage points.
budgets: At most five trials per case.
rollback: Restore 1.0.0 and migrate optional channel out.
archival_disposition: Archive rejected candidates with results and rejection reason.
